HanbokVisual.title: Celebrity & Palace Heritage Hanbok Looks
HanbokVisual.intro: Real celebrity styles worn by beloved Korean actors at Gyeongbokgung, alongside iconic palace showcase couture. Choose a look to inspire your personal styling below.
HanbokVisual.genderToggleAria: Switch between feminine and masculine style references
HanbokVisual.notice: Photography features public cultural showcases and celebratory events (KBS / Korea.net / KOCIS, CC BY & CC BY-SA). Pictured actors do not endorse Korea Concierge; references illustrate styling aesthetics.

princess-prince.name: Princess / Prince
princess-prince.tagline: Luminous pastels · Perfect for palace photos

feminine.description: Inspired by Kim Yoo-jung in Love in the Moonlight. Ethereal white silk with a delicate floral wreath — romantic, luminous, and radiant under palace sunlight.
feminine.alt: Kim Yoo-jung wearing lovely pastel Hanbok and floral crown at Gyeongbokgung

masculine.description: Inspired by Park Bo-gum in Love in the Moonlight. Classic Crown Prince scholar robe with traditional black Gat and crystal strap — aristocratic and charismatic.
masculine.alt: Park Bo-gum wearing noble scholar Hanbok and black Gat at Gyeongbokgung

feminine.description: Dignified royal court lady silhouette featuring a sheer white ceremonial cloak (jang-ot) draped over crimson jeogori and powder-blue silk chima with traditional floral binyeo.
feminine.alt: Dignified court lady Hanbok with jang-ot cloak at Gyeongbokgung Hanbok Day

masculine.description: Refined scholar prince in shimmering champagne-gold silk durumagi robe with crisp white collar, walking with effortless historical dignity.
masculine.alt: Noble scholar prince in champagne silk durumagi robe at Gyeongbokgung

feminine.description: Breathtaking grand floral fantasy gown with hand-painted cherry blossom branches over gradient pastel green and fuchsia-pink ombre silk skirts.
feminine.alt: Grand floral fantasy ombre gown Hanbok with flower tiara at Gyeongbokgung

masculine.description: Imperial court ceremonial robe in midnight black silk with crimson inner facing and traditional court crown (Wonyugwan), projecting commanding dynastic majesty.
masculine.alt: Imperial black silk court ceremonial robe and crown at Gyeongbokgung
